title: Concrete Pump Price Factors in China
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Price Factors in China | Pinjin Xingtai
description: What moves a China concrete pump quotation: model and power, configuration, wear-part kits, destination and Incoterms. Pinjin pages have no published list price and no EXW number on this site. Marketplace listing prices vary by supplier, configuration, MOQ and shipping terms.

relatedPaths.label: How to compare small concrete pumps from China

answerBlock.what: A China concrete pump price is a factory quotation, not a scraped listing. On pinjinpump.com there is no published list price and no EXW figure on product pages. Factors we actually use: catalogue model (kW, output, pressure, distance), electric versus diesel, extra pipe and wear parts, destination, and Incoterms. Marketplace listing prices vary by supplier, configuration, MOQ and shipping terms.
answerBlock.who: Importers collecting quotes who need the cost drivers without a fake price band.
factors: Which published model — compact 8–10 m³/h versus 21 m³/h versus 60–100 m³/h
Power: electric kW versus diesel engine row
Pipeline and wear-part quantity (quote-only, no small batches)
Destination, packing and who pays freight

faqs.question: What is Pinjin’s EXW price for Electric 40?
faqs.answer: This website does not publish it. Product pages state that international freight is extra and paid by the buyer. Send the model and destination for a factory quotation.

faqs.question: Can I use an Alibaba listing as the market price?
faqs.answer: Not as a Pinjin figure. Marketplace listing prices vary by supplier, configuration, MOQ and shipping terms. We do not copy those numbers.
